reason: ₹78,000 is close to a month of my salary, and our local painter would do the inside and outside of a 2BHK for much less. I'd ask Turbolux for a quote alongside two others, but I wouldn't book a fixed price I can't bargain on or check per square foot.
objection: One fixed price with no per-square-foot breakdown means I can't compare it with other quotes or haggle, and I suspect I'm paying extra for the brand name.
would_change_my_mind: A per-square-foot quote from the site visit that comes in around ₹60,000, with the finish date and the peeling guarantee in writing, so my parents don't have to deal with the crew while I'm in Dubai.
